title: Smooth positive approximation of a measurable time coefficient
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib finite-interval approximation supplement. Smooth positive approximation of a measurable time coefficient.
target_statement: For every measurable coefficient with the stated almost-everywhere range on \([a,b]\), there is a globally smooth real function \(g\) that is strictly positive and at most \(C+\varepsilon\) at every point of that interval, and whose integrated absolute error is less than \(\varepsilon\).
